cookies.intro: We use our own and third-party cookies for technical and analytical purposes, to improve our products and services, to show you personalised advertising based on a profile built from your browsing habits, and to measure the performance of ads and content.
cookies.opciones: You can accept all cookies by clicking “Accept”, reject them and/or <configurar>configure</configurar> their use.
cookies.necesariasDesc: Required for the basic operation and security of the website

analytics.desc: They let us understand how you interact with the website, which pages are most popular, and detect navigation problems. This information helps us keep improving the user experience and our services.

advertising.desc: Used to show you relevant ads based on your interests and browsing habits. Includes the use of user data for ad personalisation.

functionality.desc: They remember your preferences, such as language, region or login. These cookies make your experience smoother by keeping your settings between visits.

personalization.desc: They help us tailor the content you see to your interests. This includes product recommendations, personalised suggestions and content adapted to your profile.
